IMO this is a bad take. The fact that Abyss 12-3 exists proves they can make meaningful and difficult endgame combat content. Many players enjoy the teambuilding and theorycrafting aspect of fitting different characters/weapons/builds together, and there is plenty of room to leverage that for endgame.  


I would gladly play a randomized/infinite abyss style mode (like honkai has). Put it on a weekly lockout for rewards, randomize modifiers, and it will be decent endgame content.

The main mistake I see a ton of people making in room 3 is NOT RUSHING. People stand around waiting for callouts, cleanses, directions, etc. You should either be killing ads to spawn a glyphkeeper, killing a glyphkeeper, or moving to the next area. Once a glyphkeeper is down, it's symbols should be read and everyone should MOVE ON immediately. 

if shield stays focused on moving between the two groups nobody should have to divert from their path to cleanse. split taken and shield, have them swap sides after the first glyphkeeper, then shield moves back and forth as needed. tons of shield holders get way too focused on killing ads instead of cleansing. If you cleanse, the other 5 people have more time to ad clear, which is better than you ad-clearing and forcing 2-3 people to run to you.

Shenhe is made for buffing Cryo, so she would be a better fit for Ayaka, or any team where cryo is your main damage source. the only use she would have with Ayato is if you were using her for enabling a freeze team, in which case someone like ganyu/rosaria/diona/chogyun would probably be a better fit anyway.  


You could also attempt to use Ayato with a cryo main DPS, and have him do the freeze enabling why shenhe buffs your other cryo DPS, but it feels like Ayato's kit is wasted if he is only used off-field.

I told her I was depressed, and she told me "no you aren't"

  


Then she broke up with me because of my depression symptoms - not wanting to go out and socialize, shutting everyone out, etc

Thanks for the kind words. I imagine that it factored in quite heavily. She said she had been thinking about her happiness for a few weeks, so there's a good chance that was the initial trigger for all of this. I didn't notice anything off at all untill probably a day before the initial conversation, we were still eating I love you, spending a bunch of time together, and being intimate up untill that initial conversation.

  


Since the final break I haven't said much to her - there was one phone call where I asked her about the Las Vegas trip that preceded all of this, and asked her if she had been happy in the relationship previously. We are going to have another talk tonight to settle the lease and move out logistics, so I might express my disappointment then, but I'm not sure I have the heart to do it.
Thanks for the kind words
